verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI-native game-engine platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents user-defined rules or triggers that fire actions on events. Agent-run publishing, MCP analytics reads and CLI flags such as `--dry-run` are manual, agent-driven or adjacent features, not event-based automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
